comment: Sky Sphere textures. scripts/build_sky_textures.py renders each layer once into frontend/assets/sky/<id>.jpg (equirectangular CAR, RA 0 at the centre, RA increasing to the left, north up); that static file is the whole-sky view. 'tiles' names the survey's HiPS, from which the sphere loads sharper tiles as the view zooms in (maxOrder = the survey's hips_order; 'sliced' = this app's per-slice proxy of a HiPS cube, slice nearest cube_um).
